name: apiverket-mcp
description: Query Swedish public data through Apiverket, including company data, SCB statistics, weather, transport, and more.
long_description: Apiverket MCP gives AI agents two read-only tools for Swedish public data: govdata_discover to find relevant endpoints and govdata_query to call them. It supports company lookup, SCB statistics, weather, transport, public agencies, and other Apiverket endpoints through a consistent JSON API.

tools.name: govdata_discover
tools.description: Search and browse available Apiverket endpoints

tools.name: govdata_query
tools.description: Call a selected Apiverket endpoint and return structured JSON

govdata_api_url.description: Base URL for the Apiverket API
